items.why: AMD leads the chip sector lower as Nvidia extends its six day losing streak and forecasters worry the AI trade is on its last legs.
The fear gauge jumps as stocks head for their worst week since liberation day and the selloff snowballs across global markets.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Nvidia extends its six day losing streak as the AI rout deepens, with Michael Burry locking in gains on Nvidia puts.

market_note: Nasdaq futures are down 3.85% and S&P futures down 2.19% as the AI selloff continues.
summary: Stocks are selling off hard, with the Nasdaq wiping out its 2026 gains as the AI rout deepens. The S&P 500 and Dow are down sharply as stocks head for their worst week since liberation day.
